name: CSDM Geometry Primitives
abstract: Extends GeoSPARQL with a named subset of ISO 19107 concepts for 3D solids and 3D topology amongst features. A candidate extension for GeoSPARQL 1.1. Includes the former GeoSPARQL 3D profile placeholder module, and maps its terms to the Topo-Feature and spatial-representation ontologies used by the exchange encoding.
